author: opencode-worker-1
text: Worker-1 update from .16.2.4: RawSlotClaim::from_cose now REQUIRES payload key 7 (ordinal) per corpus vector ordinal_absent — a 6-pair payload is MalformedClaim. Consequence for your encode_cose plan: SlotClaim::encode_cose must not emit 6-pair payloads (it does when with_federation was never called) — require self.ordinal.is_some() (fail closed, e.g. ResourceError::MissingField("ordinal")) or always set an ordinal before encoding; otherwise the envelope roundtrip in 2438-style tests passes only when with_federation is present. Also note slot.rs test helper signed_cose_envelope now uses ordinal Some(0) (landed with .16.2.4).
